sections.heading: MAJOR IN FILM STUDIES
lines: Faculty of Arts and Humanities - Film Studies
Completion of first-year requirements, including Film Studies 1020E or Film Studies 1022 with a mark of at least 60%.
1.0 course in Film Studies: Film Studies 2254F/G, Film Studies 2252F/G.
0.5 course in Film Theory, Reading, and Writing from: Film Studies 3371F/G, the former Film Studies 2230F/G.

2.0 courses in Global Cinemas from: Film Studies 2242F/G, Film Studies 2244E, Film Studies 2258F/G, Film Studies 2259F/G, Film Studies 3330F/G, Film Studies 3335F/G, Film Studies 3340F/G, Film Studies 3342F/G, Film Studies 3364F/G, Film Studies 3373F/G, Film Studies 3375F/G, Film Studies 3377F/G, Film Studies 3397F/G, or an approved course offered by another Department or Faculty.
2.5 additional courses in Film Studies at the 2100 level or above or approved courses offered by other Departments or Faculties. No more than 1.0 of these courses may be at the 2100 level.
